tests.name: R19 (T53): the gate per entry — an entry with passes for draft admits draft:own_words and draft:reading; control: the same entry not_yet_rated (or not_suitable) admits neither; an entry with passes for ask and none for run admits ask and refuses check

R29 (T53): on an empty real set, an entry with passes for ask and testInstance false admits ask unlabelled; control: no entry_id admits nothing outside a test instance; the R29 controls of today hold with gateRecords empty
R30 (T53): partRefusal(part, entry_id) is AI_PART_NOT_DEPLOYED carrying the key ai.refused.aipartnotdeployed and the entry; control: no English literal in src/ for it

R36: GATE_PART_OF maps every TEST_BAR_PARTS entry to one of the six gate parts, frozen — draft:reading to draft, extract to read, the account drafts to account, the explorer's use to run; the six equal the catalogue's part list and ai-accounts' PART_OF_KIND agrees on the use kinds both name; control: gatePartOf of a name outside TEST_BAR_PARTS is null

R19 (T53), R37: the standing measure withdraws a part for one entry — a failed R75 record for entry A on the current set refuses check for A though A passed Gate 1, a later passed record restores it, and entry B with no failed record still admits check; control: a part never measured on the real set is not withdrawn
